Hi Alex,

We're ready to set up billing for GreenGrid Energy against the pilot contract (GG-4821). A couple of quick questions from our AP side before you generate the first invoice: 

- Preferred invoice delivery: we prefer automatic e-invoice (UBL/CII) into our portal, but can accept PDF by email as a fallback. Can Redwood push invoices to our portal or do you only email PDFs?

Can you loop in finance if any of these require policy exceptions? We need the first invoice by June 20 to process for month-end.

Hi Anna — thanks for the details and the VAT doc. Short answers below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Delivery options: we support two delivery modes for invoices. 
   - Portal push (preferred): We can send UBL/CII e-invoices to partner portals that accept AS2/SFTP or via Peppol where supported. This requires an integration handshake and an endpoint/format spec from your AP system.
   - Email PDF fallback: We can email a signed PDF to the AP mailbox on invoice generation (typical for small integrations).

2) VAT: We will follow EU B2B reverse charge rules when a valid VAT ID is provided and the customer is registered for intra-EU B2B. Based on the attached VAT doc we will zero-rate and include the reverse charge note on the invoice. Final confirmation will be done by finance.

3) PO: Please include the PO GG-PO-229 in the PO field; we can put that on the invoice header so your AP system picks it up.

Next steps / timeline:
- I'll provision the invoice delivery route. If you want a portal push, could your AP team send the integration endpoint details (SFTP host + user or Peppol ID) by EOD Monday?
- I'll attach a sample invoice (PDF) so you can validate field mapping.
- Laura (finance) will confirm VAT treatment and final wording on the invoice. Marcus (operations) will track the portal integration.

I've attached a sample PDF invoice for layout reference.

Best,
Alex Martinez
